A [[Mon Calamari]] '''aristocrat''' was present at the [[Galaxies Opera House]] to complement [[Doctor]] [[Penn Pershing]] after his speech.<ref name="Chapter 19" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The aristocrat appeared in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Lee Isaac Chung]]. [[Norwood Cheek]] portrayed the character and the voice.<ref name="Chapter 19" />
